shell_commands: npx prettier --check src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && echo "✓ Formatting OK"

git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(tools): validate extra properties pass through to executor

Add unit test verifying that valid input with unlisted extra properties
is passed unchanged to the executor, without modification or filtering.
Fixes import statement and formatting for ajv validator integration.
EOF
)" && git log -1 --format='%H %s'
git push origin HEAD && git status
timeout 60 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Suites|Tests:|PASS|FAIL"
